name: sol8-usage-preview-fit
goal: Show hidden consumers at a zero limit and keep usage previews inside their owner without covering its title.

evidence: Zero-limit footers must distinguish hidden consumers from an empty list; fixed usage previews must fit their owner and leave its title visible.
The standard catalog checked hidden overflow text and tooltip content but not painted zero-limit text, owner edges or title intersection. Extend those existing assertions.
3eaa1c3e0a at 754437103c fails zero-limit visibility and owner left-edge assertions after retaining all nine affected screenshots.
30f1333351 and 01d4afec70 show zero-limit counts and anchor previews inside the containing card, away from its title.
Final green record at 01d4afec70 passes all nine unchanged state/viewport assertions; final red 9dbef82290 fails all nine.
